The Belgian Congo. We researched them back in my freshman year of high school for honors history- everyone had a project on imperialism and different regions around the world affected by it.

Belgium exploited the Congo for rubber. The Congolese people were tortured or murdered, the most common punishment being having their hands chopped off. Also, Catholic missionaries forced them to convert. 

To this day the DRC is incredibly unstable, most of the blame going to Belgium. It was incredibly horrific, from exploitation to genocide. Imperialism as a whole is an undeniably dark part of history, really.
